decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Institutional training, workshops and project meetings involving staff from multiple provinces, with a secondary possibility of transient accommodation for visiting executives, technical teams or external partners.
decisionProcess.summary: Sourcing is partially accessible. INAPA publishes procurement and transparency material and has an official contact route, while public evidence identifies Administrative, Purchases and HR roles. The reviewed material does not reveal a hotel-sourcing policy, travel-management company, preferred hotel list, accommodation tender or named event-sourcing owner.
decisionProcess.notes: Treat INAPA as a public-sector procurement account. Ask first whether accommodation and meetings are procured through the central Administrative/Purchases function, an approved vendor process, a project/donor budget, or local/provincial discretion. Do not assume a direct sales agreement bypasses public procurement.
unknowns: Whether training and meetings are residential, and whether accommodation is sourced centrally, locally, by HR, by Administration/Procurement or by an external partner.
Whether the hotel has the required public-sector vendor registration, invoicing, tax and competitive-procurement capabilities.
Whether INAPA’s current procurement leadership has authority to select a hotel or only administers a formal process.
The hotel’s official address, website, brand and detailed meeting capacities remain unresolved in the supplied hotel context.
